message:
feat(seo): English mirror pages + restore bright dark-theme text

- item pages now generated in both languages: /item/<slug>/ (ru) and
  /en/item/<slug>/ (en), with correct hreflang alternates and x-default
- new English landing page at /en/ listing the 24 highest-value items
- prerendered copy is fully translated (titles, labels, table headers, CTAs)
- app forces English when loaded from an /en/... path
- removed the blanket dark-theme text overrides that were dimming every
  text-neutral-* colour; the dark theme is bright again
- shared the item-page stylesheet and theme-boot script between all generated
  pages instead of duplicating them per template
author: BSS Index Developer
